unit.title: Seva, the Golden Temple, and Gratitude

lesson.title: Bringing It Together: A Week of Gratitude
lesson.subject: sikhi

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned about Langar's real jobs, the Golden Temple's pool, and Ardas. Today: see how gratitude connects all three!

Look at the thread connecting this whole week: Seva at Langar is done with a thankful, giving spirit; the Golden Temple is a place people visit to feel a sense of peace and gratitude; and Ardas is literally a prayer of thanks and guidance. Gratitude shows up in action (Langar), in a special place (the Golden Temple), and in words (Ardas). Describe one way you could show gratitude this week, connecting to something you learned.
You just connected a whole week of learning around one real theme: gratitude, shown in action, in place, and in words. Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Identify gratitude as the connecting theme across this week's three lessons
Describe one personal way to show gratitude, connected to this week's content
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's three earlier lessons: Langar jobs, the Amrit Sarovar, Ardas.
2. Discuss how gratitude connects all three — in action, in place, and in words.
3. Have the child describe their own way to show gratitude this week.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just one of the three connections (like Langar as gratitude-in-action) rather than requiring all three at once
Ready for more: ask the child to think of one more example of gratitude shown in action, place, or words, beyond this week's specific lessons
This synthesis lesson is a good moment to make the whole week feel like one coherent story, not three separate facts
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a discussion and reflection activity — check that the child can explain gratitude as this week's connecting theme and describe one genuine personal way to show it.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Synthesizes the course's Seva, Golden Temple, and prayer descriptions into one coherent theme (gratitude), deepening this week's three separate lessons into a connected understanding.
